title: Quickly Cured Russian Strawberry Pilaf
description: A peppery and crumbly Russian dish featuring strawberries and shio-cure, perfect for midnight cravings, and Whole30-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the sliced strawberries and shio cure, letting it sit for 10 minutes to allow the strawberries to quickly cure.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the cauliflower rice to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until it is tender and lightly browned.
Add the black pepper and salt to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the chopped fresh dill and lemon juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the quickly cured strawberries to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until the strawberries are heated through.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
